row: Welcome! I'm Miri, a licensed Occupational Therapist and a Doctor of Occupational Therapy. OT Miri was created in December 2016 to bring together a community of people with a shared passion towards a common goal- to become a confident, competent and compassionate Occupational Therapy practitioner. The content, opinions and strategies covered in my videos are not a substitute for academic coursework, medical advice, diagnosis or treatment and should not be viewed as such. NBCOT® is a registered trademark owned by National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy, Inc. OT Miri is not affiliated with or endorsed by National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy, Inc. Thank you for your continued support, love and engagement. Your OT, Miri.
